newsitem.title: USA: Tremont Corp sees full-year 1997 profitability.
newsitem.headline: Tremont Corp sees full-year 1997 profitability.

text.p: Tremont Corp said on Friday that despite reporting a first-quarter loss it expects strong demand for titanium products to make the company profitable for full-year 1997.
Tremont reported a loss of $2.4 million, or $0.32 per share, compared to a profit of $2.2 million, or $0.29 per share, for the same period a year ago.
Tremont attributed part of its loss to a special $30 million charge taken by NL Industries Inc, in which Tremont has an 18 percent stake.
The loss to Tremont was $0.70 per share from this charge, which was from adopting a new accounting standard for environmental remediation liabilities.

But continuing strength in the titanium metals business, particularly in aerospace, and strong demand for NL's TiO2 titanium dioxide pigments should make Tremont profitable for the year, the company said.
